title: Pir Abdul Qadir Shah Jeelani Institute of Medical Sciences Gambat Amendment Act 2017

sections.shortTitle: Pir Abdul Qadir Shah Jeelani Institute of Medical Sciences Gambat Amendment Act 2017
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XX OF 2017
ACT XX
OF 2017
PIR ABDUL
QADIR SHAH JEELANI INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES, GAMBAT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act to further amend the Pir
Abdul Qadir Shah Jeelani
Institute of Medical Sciences, Gambat Act, 2005
[Gazette
of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 8th June, 2017]
No.PAS/LEGIS-PB-04/2017, dated
8.6.2017.---Pir Abdul Qadir
Shah Jeelani Institute of Medical Sciences, Gambat (Amendment) Bill, 2017 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 21st April, 2017 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 15th May,
2017 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS
it is expedient to further amend the Pir Abdul Qadi Shah Jeelani Institute of
Medical Sciences, Gambat Act, 2005, in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called Pir Abdul Qadir
Shah Jeelani Institute of Medical Sciences, Gambat (Amendment) Act, 2017.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment of section 8 of Sindh Act No. V of 2006.---In the Pir Abdul Qadir Shah Jeelani Institute of Medical Sciences, Gambat
Act, 2005, in section 8,
1. In
subsection (iv) the words "District Nazims"
be replaced with the words "District Chairman".
2. After
subsection (iv) following new subsection be added as:
(v) Four
Members of the Provincial Assembly of Sindh are to be
nominated by the Speaker, Provincial Assembly of Sindh;
(vi) One
MNA to be nominated by the Speaker National Assembly of Pakistan;
(vii) One
Senior Citizen belonging to District Khairpur Mir's
is to be nominated by the Board.
And the rest of the serial numbers
be renumbered accordingly.
